docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Kern’s edition of Āryabhaṭa’s Āryabhaṭīya with the commentary of Paramādīśvara, the first printed text of the astronomical and mathematical work of 499 A.D. (Leiden, 1874). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the University of California Libraries; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The Aryabhatiya; with the commentary Bhatadîpikâ of Paramâdîçvara · Aryabhata, b. 476, Paramesvara, astronomer. Bhatadipika, Kern, H. (Hendrik), 1833-1917 · 1874, 132 scanned pages. Published 1874; Hendrik Kern died 1917; the text is of the fifth century; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the text of this book is in a script the machine reading of the scans cannot yet give.
